title: Both share the fault
odia: ଆଲୋ ମୁତୁରି ଶୋଇବା, ତୁ ମୁତୁରୀ କି ମୁଁ ମୁତୁରା ହେଂସ କାହିଁପାଇଁ ଧୋଇବା...!!!
literal_meaning: Come, bed-wetter, let us sleep. Are you the bed-wetter, or am I? Why wash the mat?
explanation: The licensed page places this crude joke in the situation of two people sharing the same fault. One possible reading is that their shared embarrassment lets both excuse leaving things as they are. The specific suggestion of mutual indulgence is an editorial interpretation; the witness does not supply a detailed explanation. This bodily image should not be used to shame someone with an actual condition.
meaning_odia: ଦୁଇ ଜଣଙ୍କର ଏକା ପ୍ରକାର ଅସୁବିଧା ଥିବାରୁ ସଜାଡ଼ିବାର କାମକୁ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେବାର ଭାବ ଏଥିରୁ ନିଆଯାଇପାରେ। ଏହି ପାଠରେ ଜଣଙ୍କ ତ୍ରୁଟି ଆଉ ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଅଜୁହାତ ହୋଇଯାଉଛି। ଏହା ଏକ ସୀମିତ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା; ଶାରୀରିକ ସମସ୍ୟା ଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ଲଜ୍ଜିତ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଉପମାଟି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବା ଉଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Two members who both missed a deadline agree not to mention either delay at the meeting. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)

english_summary: A crude joke places two people in the same fault; their shared embarrassment may let both excuse leaving things unchanged.
